items.text: Lamar Jackson listed IN/no designation on final injury report and expected to play vs Bills after ankle injury; small docks on rushing projected.
items.why: Full practice, not on final report; Rapoport/Schefter corroborate return.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens pass catchers, especially Flowers; QB1 upside with some rush limit.
items.opportunity: Full snaps likely, rushing slightly docked.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed IN, not on final injury report despite hamstring/back; playing vs Commanders but Levitan shocked and doubts 100%.
items.why: Cleared final report; Schefter/Rap confirm good to go.
items.implication: Startable but re-injury risk high; limited expected.
items.opportunity: Workhorse if healthy but manage carefully.
items.conflict: Berry hates/fades due to usage/injury concerns.

items.text: RJ Harvey ruled OUT (knee) for Broncos vs Chiefs; Waddle Q (chest).
items.implication: No clean replacement; 3-6 extra targets available in DEN offense.
items.opportunity: Target share bump for Waddle (if active) or other pass-catchers; Coleman/Dobbins backfield.

items.text: Colts now open to trading Jonathan Taylor; multiple teams interested, talks active/ongoing.
items.implication: Hold/monitor; value could spike or situation change pre-deadline.

items.text: Breece Hall Q (quad) again with cryptic tweet and trade rumors; thought close last week.
items.why: Limited practice, Q tag, personal tweet ambiguous.
items.implication: GTD; if out Braelon Allen elevated. Monitor inactives.

items.text: Carnell Tate (shoulder) and Tyjae Spears (knee) OUT.
items.why: ETR Sunday board and Schefter out list.
items.implication: TEN WR/RB depth hit; Ridley Q, more for others.
items.opportunity: Target/carry bump for TEN skill players.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks ruled OUT; Barkley clear.
items.implication: PHI WR targets consolidate; A.J. Brown or others if active, or TE/Goedert bump.
items.opportunity: Higher target share for remaining PHI pass catchers.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka taken OUT of projections (concussion, foot); fallout viewed in ETR projs.
items.implication: TB WR depth thins; Godwin/others elevated if healthy.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining TB WRs.

items.text: AJ Brown taken OUT of ETR projections (knee); listed Q on board but multi-week concerns noted.
items.implication: NE WR targets to others; monitor official.
items.opportunity: Bump for remaining NE pass catchers.

items.text: Josh Jacobs strong fantasy value via high-value touches: 3 inside-5 carries + 13 targets in 2 games post-suspension (Jeanty parallel).
items.why: Goal-line and target volume king; efficiency bonus.
items.implication: RB1/2 lock; Berry also loves vs CAR.

items.text: Zay Flowers LOVE/WR5; Lamar expected back unlocks him in track-meet vs Bills.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share and TDs with Jackson.

items.text: Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG (top-5 TE both weeks) since Caleb Williams returned.
items.why: Leads position in utilization post-Williams return.

items.text: Sell high on Quinshon Judkins after 2-TD outing; role hit with Dylan Sampson back (season-low snaps/targets).
items.why: Passing-game role significantly reduced post-Sampson return; Berry notes same.
items.implication: Trade now while value high; still lead back but fewer targets.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle HATE; production lacking, Chiefs allow just 1 WR TD all year (to JSN).
items.why: Tough matchup + recent lack of production; also Q chest.
items.conflict: Harvey OUT could free targets if Waddle plays.
